  - "**Divergence:** in **PoderData/Aya** the margin falls from 5 to 2 points between two waves, and **Gerp**, with fieldwork closed on the same October 12, measures 9."

## 1. Prediction market

**The gap narrows.** In the confirmed reading of October 13 at 16:14 BRT, the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) pays 86.45% for Flávio Bolsonaro (USD 19.80M) and 13.50% for Lula (USD 22.49M). Against the confirmed reading of October 12 at 15:00 BRT, Lula rises 1.00pp and Flávio Bolsonaro falls 0.60pp; since the sum of the pair went from 99.55 to 99.95, the normalized movement is 0.95pp to each side. The gap goes from 74.55pp to 72.95pp. In the 19:04 BRT re-reading, Flávio Bolsonaro was at 86.25% and Lula at 13.50%, and the total accumulated volume in the presidential book added up to USD 180.94M. The largest volume in the book is still Lula's.

**Supreme Court and inflation.** The contract on the [impeachment of an STF justice before 2027](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) stands at 2.35% (USD 0.10M) in the confirmed reading of 16:14 BRT, 0.80pp below the 3.15% of October 12. In the [2026 inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) one, the 5.00% to 5.49% range leads with 46.50% (USD 25 thousand) in the 19:04 BRT reading, and the 4.50% to 4.99% range falls from 37.35% to 26.90% (USD 32 thousand) against October 12, while the 5.50% to 5.99% range rises from 12.55% to 16.05% (USD 21 thousand). The [Focus Bulletin](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/miriam-leitao/post/2026/10/boletim-focus-projecao-para-inflacao-tem-quarta-alta-consecutiva-e-salta-para-522percent.ghtml) of October 12 raised the 2026 IPCA projection from 5.01% to 5.22%.

## 2. What the polling firms registered

**Four national polls.** [PoderData/Aya](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNSUhLdnZXRnlJRlRabjcwWndNTXdKbENoTTNpZVdVSGs4YzdlSmlkSGg4Q084Rk1OemJPU2JyODNoSjA0eUZ6SjFPc2tTOHhTNUxCZ2pGd2dENmhBVzZIWlNOYUlLbENYZG5vbEItY0lVRFhnVWM4TV94clpnYkUzX3A0ckphUzhJVXg1LWJGMjU5cGd5MG1xRg?oc=5), with 3,000 interviews from October 10 to 12, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 48% and Lula 46%, 51% to 49% in valid votes. [BTG/Nexus](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNcUtVVWh1RkVMZmhOZWVpbW1nVk8yTFpiZFJIMEQ4YjhyMnAzN3U0WnhFakxoQmVlR2tkWDJkejlZOTByLWlIai13NzFPNlo2WnpOSWRCWjFVekZoM1U0Q3BFWGNGTzlUSEE3bGZ3Rm1SWGtQTno4bG5xNW9TeFZJTUJ3MW5HQVFLcWJuX3JCYUsxbTN3QUE?oc=5), with 2,002 interviews on the same days, gives 48% to 45%, 52% to 48% in valid votes. [Futura/100% Cidades](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOd1pBRVNCQXZyeEx5djJhdkVWU0k0WUNTRmZ3cWdxSDUzSDAyUFBmUWlldDNGNG1zTWstSEdQN3ZBRHZuWmpydTBEQm1UcDg1cXdYTEdVekpfZ2N5R04tOFpabUFDODluSWwzNkl5a0ZrRWMtNkljdTZrWHViREdCQjAwXzFWLTZCMDcwMndUTGJDOTlwRjFDQlEzb3ZyWW5nQTN2eE9lc1FVSXdOQUxCaQ?oc=5), with 2,000 interviews from October 7 to 10, gives 50% to 46.6%, 51.8% to 48.2% in valid votes. [Gerp](https://news.google.?oc=5), released on the night of October 12, with 2,400 interviews on October 8, 9 and 12, gives 53% to 44%, [55% to 45% in valid votes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQdDV2ckxMbUhLMUtRQWtYc0F3bWI0Q0RSNFFtQ0FHOWw0M1lHeThJcWhoVHBPY2dlTzd1UGhRS3RuU1dMc19XMGNmc2hxVWY5bVZMMDM0aWhXd2F3SWxmY3cyeXQ0LUdDQWRRaVR4ekprSWc4akg1YTltTlZtaHEyWmtrZmtLMVJaQTRnRUxWOFBuWDYxSWRkT2xOdw?oc=5).

**The post-vote map.** Of the ten national polls conducted after the first round, nine put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, by 2 to 9 points in total votes, and Vox Brasil of October 9 puts Lula ahead by 1.5 points. In PoderData/Aya, the margin falls from 5 points in the October 5 to 7 wave to 2 in the October 10 to 12 wave, within the margin of error of 1.8 points. On rejection, [46% would not vote for Lula under any circumstances and 44% would not vote for Flávio Bolsonaro](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPRmVMWUN2LUFhWDd5T3RtT3FXQnRlOU5fN0ZHeTRkM21mTzJGeHVTRkU4dnFiZUJUYUpCTGc2UGpXQ21uWGZwWWhZUVRZenZWVFRXNDlyNXhiVzFabVVSSXhhSWVjcWpTU3YxLUVYSWRuLTdvMUhoRXUzWnBBcFBpYUtZX0c1TkdKcFM1bzJUczBpTElBOHpF?oc=5) in PoderData/Aya; in BTG/Nexus, 51% and 47%. The poll side of the panel's graph is now PoderData/Aya, the largest sample among the national polls of October 13.

**The registry.** Two of the week's commitments left the TSE registry: AtlasIntel of October 15 and Vox Brasil of October 16, which has another national poll registered for October 18. The press confirms [Quaest on October 14](https://news.google.?oc=5) and Datafolha on October 15.

## 3. What the press covered

**The 6x1 and the MDB.** After visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest, Flávio Bolsonaro [said he will vote in favor of ending the 6x1 work schedule (six days on, one off)](https://news.google.?oc=5) in the Senate and [asked for compensation for companies](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/flavio-diz-que-votara-pelo-fim-da-escala-6x1-e-defende-compensacao-a-empresarios/); Lula [attributed the change to pressure from society](https://news.google.?oc=5). The Senate has the [vote on the proposal scheduled for October 14](https://news.google.?oc=5). In São Paulo, alongside Tarcísio de Freitas and Ricardo Nunes, MDB president Baleia Rossi [formalized the support of 17 state branches for Flávio Bolsonaro](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/mdb-oficializa-apoio-majoritario-a-flavio-mas-mantem-ala-favoravel-a-lula/), and [ten branches from the North and Northeast declared support for Lula](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPdGxkTnA5Sm44aXo4Wk8tSHduY05IUUpNMzVIS0V2WFVhWmlEOXJ2NUcyS1VkTVNZUk5wNWlSbEF0eU56TlVhcktlbjBZbGExNmxsUkhPV0JKMFRzNmJsOU92ZU5oYW9hQkE5SXhudGVnRURzUkZKT2xMTWk4VXFIci1VZnRCYXhmRUxYVm9lYW4tYndReGVLUDIyV0dhTDFxaXlFN1hETlFmMUg2WnZSandTTVExdEJjRHU3MW1tRUJyZUk?oc=5).

**The TSE.** Kassio Nunes Marques [took down the "Exército do Lula" (Lula's Army) channel again](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/eleicoes/campanha-de-lula-cumpre-decisao-do-tse-e-registra-canal-de-janones-no-tse/), overturning the decision of inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, and required the channel to be registered with the Electoral Court; Lula's campaign registered it the same day, and Kassio [authorized its resumption, which only takes effect 48 hours after the registration](https://g1.globo.com/politica/eleicoes/2026/noticia/2026/10/13/nunes-marques-diz-que-apos-registro-canal-de-whatsapp-exercito-do-lula-pode-ser-retomado-apos-48-horas.ghtml). Kassio also [brought the two campaigns together](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOQUFteTBzNjZ2RHRYYWw4UXB0NDU4TU94dkZsS2xNVnpfdjNCWVBnZ2JGZzYxclY1SC0wZTdkS2xqVkFfMjVIX21sMDhNNDB2QUVJNmRUbjVMN0pmZW9mdUxfeFVtbWV5VHpETXRwbEpzM3drVDVNNFlIY0tmcWxrRjIyOHRMOHd5TVJGQlZaYUlhNnlRazRNQUFjZTBxMllzejAwazJjMnBjRWNwZnBVUEQ4OFk?oc=5) and demanded actions against confrontations. Justice André Mendonça [ordered Lula's posts removed within three hours](https://news.google.?oc=5) that link the "tesouraço", a fiscal squeeze proposed by Flávio Bolsonaro, to cuts in social programs, with a fine of R$ 10 thousand for noncompliance.

**The agenda.** Lula announced [Prospera MEI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOR3hpN3FnWUZueWVsek5EcDA5Qzg1bnFGMWxORXZjc1ZMWlRiTnZLSUVxX0pITWdmWlJVZkh2aVBtV2plSnFMZ1Y1R1hST3lWZzVJUmgzVGx3eDJtN3lIdnJ5UC14N2hfblhYa1c5NnZVWHFHTjBPRURuWmhGelFpcmdibmhKTDZsUUpDSWlFblAyby1TVlk0aUc3Rk9wOW9Wd0tmNXhDcw?oc=5), with an estimated forgiveness of R$ 12.6 billion in debts of microentrepreneurs and a Pix payment of up to R$ 5 thousand, with part of it scheduled [only from 2027 onward](https://www.estadao.com.br/economia/pix-de-r-5-mil-para-meis-anunciado-por-lula-so-podera-ser-pago-a-partir-de-2027/), and [promised a Pé-de-Meia for university students](https://g1.globo.com/politica/eleicoes/2026/noticia/2026/10/13/lula-pe-de-meia-universitarios.ghtml) if he is reelected. Flávio Bolsonaro said he [will not attend the Band debate](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxONlhOM3FGMEN5bGpmUm9oRkgxOHpuSWVFcnRKNDJFUldnQl81TmkzbFRiMndRSjBoSmM2M0JSVDJCcnFjVzBSRkFjcTZZdXhfcWlKX1ZweDk1Zms0X0lFYWJRSEhNN2dFWVJDblVsbGNIaEFXZUoxNnk3dG8ySjIyaThWcG5jcTQxT3dadDJEWlVWbDkwY3RFdGFtVlRoN01pTElLakF6UlRVYjRLSEZOLVFXQWpadw?oc=5), scheduled for October 18, and that he is weighing the Globo one, on October 23.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Poll × poll:** with fieldwork closed on the same October 12, [Gerp](https://news.google.?oc=5) measures 9 points for Flávio Bolsonaro and [PoderData/Aya](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNSUhLdnZXRnlJRlRabjcwWndNTXdKbENoTTNpZVdVSGs4YzdlSmlkSGg4Q084Rk1OemJPU2JyODNoSjA0eUZ6SjFPc2tTOHhTNUxCZ2pGd2dENmhBVzZIWlNOYUlLbENYZG5vbEItY0lVRFhnVWM4TV94clpnYkUzX3A0ckphUzhJVXg1LWJGMjU5cGd5MG1xRg?oc=5) measures 2. Among the four of October 12 and 13, the margin ranges from 2 to 9 points in total votes.

> **Market × poll:** on the day the four national polls measured Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) narrowed the gap from 74.55pp to 72.95pp, with Lula rising 1.00pp. Price measures the probability of winning on October 25, and the poll measures the week's voting intention.

> **Market × Focus:** the leading range in the [2026 inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) contract, 5.00% to 5.49%, contains the 5.22% that the [Focus Bulletin](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/miriam-leitao/post/2026/10/boletim-focus-projecao-para-inflacao-tem-quarta-alta-consecutiva-e-salta-para-522percent.ghtml) projects for the year, and the 4.50% to 4.99% range lost 10.45 points against October 12.

## In summary

1. **Four national polls measure Flávio Bolsonaro ahead by 2 to 9 points**, and nine of the ten conducted after the vote put him in the lead.
2. **The winner contract narrows the gap to 72.95pp**, with Lula at 13.50% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 86.45%.
3. **Flávio Bolsonaro votes to end the 6x1 and receives the formal support of the MDB**, with ten of the party's branches on Lula's side.
